subject.title: refactor(channels): move channel-flavored setup flags into plugin manifests

question: Can this core release require the compatible `@openclaw/nextcloud-talk` plugin version, or must legacy aliases remain available until installed plugin upgrades are guaranteed?
rationale: The architecture direction is supported by the linked program, but selecting the supported upgrade contract for separately installed official plugins is a release/compatibility decision that cannot safely be inferred from the patch.

options.title: Ship atomically with upgrade proof
options.body: Publish the compatible Nextcloud Talk plugin in the same train and add proof that a pre-existing packaged installation upgrades without losing legacy aliases.

options.title: Retain a temporary compatibility boundary
options.body: Keep a narrow version-aware compatibility path until the host can guarantee the installed plugin supplies `prepareAccountConfigInput`.

options.title: Accept the breaking upgrade
options.body: Intentionally document that legacy aliases stop working for old installed plugins and own the support impact.

recommendation.title: Ship atomically with upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Publish the compatible Nextcloud Talk plugin in the same train and add proof that a pre-existing packaged installation upgrades without losing legacy aliases.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the related ownership program and the proposed host/plugin boundary change.
